# CANDIDATE: shotgun_scalper_stage2_top_keeper

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)

## Hypothesis

The strategy uses tight stops (30% premium stop), short time stops (10 min), and OTM-2 strikes to capture quick mean-reversion moves in high-volume conditions. The edge appears to come from avoiding large losses on choppy days while scratching small wins in trending micro-moves, but it fails to capture the structural bearish moves that define J's winner days.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Triggered when volume ratio > 1.2 (current bar volume / 20-bar average volume) and other internal shotgun_scalper conditions (not detailed in keeper output).
- **Exit:** 
  - Premium stop at -30% of entry premium (catastrophe cap)
  - Time stop at 10 minutes after entry
  - Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% favorable move (based on chandelier_arm_pct=0.5) and trails 15% off high-water mark (inferred from standard v14_enhanced logic)
  - TP1 at +50% premium (tp_premium_pct=0.5) at 2/3 position size (standard scale-out)
- **Contract selection:** OTM-2 puts (strike_offset=2) for bearish bias, 0DTE.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and OTM-2 strike premium (~$1.50 entry implies ~$420/trade risk, max 2 contracts at $1K).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size is 16 months (2025-01 to 2026-06) with walk-forward splits unknown; selection method is parameter sweep over 1458 combos; high overfit risk due to optimizing on wide_pnl without OP-16 constraints.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window reported in keeper output).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated with real OPRA fills; BS-sim likely overestimates ITM-2 0DTE entry premium per L23).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/05 (-$36) 
   - Max drawdown: unknown -- requires full equity curve 
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion causing repeated stop-outs (10-min time stop) combined with adverse slippage on OTM-2 strikes.
6. **Concentration:** top5_pct=18.4% (top 5 days = 18.4% of P&L), indicating low concentration (good), but quarterly P&L shows all 6 quarters positive, suggesting possible overfit to steady upward drift rather than regime-specific edge.
